name: zmath_vec3_normalize
description: zMath::Vec3Normalize normalizes a nonzero vector in place and returns its original 3D length, leaving zero vectors unchanged.
known_limits: Source placement is modeled as an address-backed zmth.h inline helper. The header-layering repair keeps the inline body in zmth.h, exposes early math types/declarations through zmth_types.h and zmth_decls.h, and includes full zmth.h in ai_net.cpp after AINet::AiFinalizeMode2State1ForAllPlayers. Current VC5SP3 evidence byte-matches the helper itself and preserves the generated COFF order slot between 0x402f10 and 0x402fd0; broader ai_net.cpp block tier S remains blocked by sibling AINet byte drift.
Binary Ninja HLIL loses the x87 stack value at fdivrp and renders the reciprocal scale as 1/1; disassembly confirms the assembly computes 1/length and returns the saved length.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x402f60 computes sqrt(x*x + y*y + z*z), leaves zero-length vectors unchanged, scales nonzero vectors by the reciprocal length, and returns the original length.
The native smoke checks a 3/4/12 vector normalization and return length, plus zero-vector no-op behavior.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 zmath_vec3_normalize passed on 2026-07-05 for ?Vec3Normalize@zMath@@YIMPAUzVec3@@@Z at 0x402f60 with zero unmasked byte mismatches, zero relocation bytes, zero trailing NOP trims, BN size 98, and VC5 size 98 under profile vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs. The target compiles src/Battlesport/ai_net.cpp so the zmth.h inline helper COMDAT is emitted at the intended ai_net.cpp slot. python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 ainet_text_block_order still fails overall because sibling AINet functions drift, but reports section_order_matches_manifest True and the 0x402f60 row byte-clean between AINet::AiFinalizeMode2State1ForAllPlayers at 0x402f10 and AINet::LoadAllFromZrd at 0x402fd0.
